name: 2024-2c-parcial2-masked
title: Orchard Harvester
description: A simplified orchard harvester prototype: a harvester bot and two scarecrow drones move on a hedge-lined board where the harvester collects small and large fruit for points, with lives, score, tick-delayed drones that pick random directions at hedges, and a game-over condition. The student must build the whole game model on top of a given StringOrchardBoard that parses and visits a string representation of the board, and must produce that representation back for the tests.

design.notes: A heterogeneous board of hedges, fruit, bare ground, drones and the harvester built through a visitor, where drones must remember what they cover, start after different tick counts and choose directions from a random 1-5 mapping, plus lives, score and game-over; the reference solution itself had a drone-over-fruit game-over bug, showing how subtle the element/collision model is.
